'''Syncloth sheets''' were a type of bedsheet made of [[syncloth]] available in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone wars]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Doctor/Legends|Surgeon]] [[Jos Vondar]] used a syncloth sheet as the cover for the cot in his cubicle in [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syncloth sheets first appeared in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]], the first book in the [[MedStar Duology]] written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] which was published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Appearances==
*''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''
